charts.title: WASP-5 b: orbits around WASP-5
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-5's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-5 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Sodickson & Grunblatt 2025 (2025ApJ...993...78S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SODICKSON__AMP__GRUNBLATT_2025): P 1.62842992377 d

charts.title: WASP-5 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-5 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (103, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 184240683, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
